subject: Quick correction on the reading group date
text: Hi Professor, I hope your week is going well. I just wanted to clarify something silly on my end because I misread the calendar entry for the reading group. I thought we were meeting in the library annex, but the invite says the seminar room, so I will head over there instead. Thanks for sending the reminder, although I suspect I only half looked at it while juggling coffee and a stack of papers. Please also let me know if you would like me to bring any handouts for the discussion section, or if the short essay has been moved to the course page. I am happy to grab a couple of books if that helps. Sorry for the mix-up, and thanks again for your patience. Best,
